title: Agent Installer Schema
description: Data-driven schema for the agent installer. Each phase produces a section of the generated docs/ tree and .opencode/ tree.

questions.prompt: Project name (kebab-case, used as docs id)
One-line description of what this project does
Secrets source (env, gcp-secret-manager, aws-sm, vault, none)
Backend folder structure (one entry per line, e.g. cmd/server/main.go - entry point)
Project slices - the major 'pizza slices' that the orchestrator should route on. Format per line: slice_id | description | entry paths (comma) | primary agents (comma)
examples: backend | Core API + business logic | internal/,cmd/ | coder,reviewer

phases.title: Phase 2 - Context Docs and Protocols
phases.description: Generates docs/context/*.md (strategic docs), docs/protocols/*.md (project protocols), and .opencode/protocols/*.md (agent protocols). Each selected item becomes a stub file with placeholder content; the human fills in the substance later. Use the protocol_templates section as the index.

questions.prompt: Which context docs do you want to enable? (comma-separated ids; lives in docs/context/)

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.default_body:
## Layers

Describe the layers in your architecture (e.g. transport -> service -> repository -> domain).

## Dependency rules

What can import what.

api-contracts.title: API Contracts
api-contracts.default_body:
## HTTP status codes

Document which codes you use and when.

## Response shape

Standard success and error envelopes.

## Pagination

Cursor vs offset, page size limits.

business-logic.title: Business Logic
business-logic.default_body:
## Domain rules

List the most important business invariants.

## Workflows

Step-by-step flows that cross multiple modules.

rules.title: Development Rules
rules.default_body:
## Coding standards

Linter, formatter, naming conventions.

## Error handling

How errors are defined, propagated, and translated to HTTP.

## Security

Input validation, secrets, auth checks.

naming-registry.title: Naming Registry
naming-registry.default_body:
## DB <-> Go <-> JSON mapping

Document the canonical names per layer.

context-chunking-strategy.title: Context Chunking Strategy
context-chunking-strategy.default_body: If you use local models with limited context, document the chunking rules here.

docker-strategy.title: Docker Strategy
docker-strategy.default_body:
## Base images

Multi-stage build details.

## Compose profiles

dev, test, prod.

indexing-strategy.title: Indexing Strategy
indexing-strategy.default_body: How docs are tagged for fast lookup by documentation-search tools and the explorer agent.

permission-architecture.title: Permission Architecture
permission-architecture.default_body:
## Data structure

How permissions are represented (bitmask, JSON, etc.).

## Database

Tables, TTL, invalidation.

## Service

Resolution logic.

## Endpoints

Routes and middleware.

permission-troubleshooting.title: Permission Troubleshooting
permission-troubleshooting.default_body: Common issues and fixes for the permission system.

postgres-strategy.title: PostgreSQL Strategy
postgres-strategy.default_body: Single source of truth for how this project uses PostgreSQL through GORM. Document GORM conventions (context propagation, soft deletes, no raw SQL), naming & types (DB <-> Go <-> JSON), migration workflow, indexes, the UNLOGGED cache pattern, performance considerations, security, and common pitfalls. Cross-references architecture.md, rules.md, permission-architecture.md, and naming-registry.md.

_meta.description: Project protocols (docs/protocols/) and agent protocols (.opencode/protocols/). Each enabled protocol is copied as a stub with a placeholder body. The human fills in the substance. Protocol ids are kebab-case and match the file basename (without .md).

scopes.project: Lives under docs/protocols/<id>.md and describes how THIS project works (stack, layers, naming, conventions).
scopes.agent: Lives under .opencode/protocols/<id>.md and describes how the agent system coordinates (canonicalization, scope reduction, interruption bus, etc.).

api-endpoint-factory.title: API Endpoint Factory
api-endpoint-factory.default_body: Reusable template for creating CRUD endpoints in this project. Document the mandatory layering (domain -> repository -> service -> handler -> router -> DI), file locations, and code templates.

canonical-prompter.title: Canonical Prompter
canonical-prompter.default_body: Phase 1 of the delivery pipeline. Document term resolution, classification (bug/task/feature-design/update), module identification, hint extraction, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and clarification rules.

context-reductor.title: Context Reductor
context-reductor.default_body: Phase 2 of the delivery pipeline. Document scope boundaries, complexity levels (Baja->Muy Alta), hot spot types, hidden assumption detection, and verification path.

interruption.title: Interruption Bus
interruption.default_body: File-based pause/resume bus. Document traffic-light.md (semaforo), interruption-log.md (append-only audit trail), and per-agent memory (reasoning-full.md + summary.md).

session-archiver.title: Session Archiver
session-archiver.default_body: Session closeout distillation. Reads per-agent reasoning-full.md and produces session-digest.md with decisions, lessons, open questions, and links.

sessions-setup.title: Sessions Setup
sessions-setup.default_body: Opencode home bootstrap conventions (~/.config/opencode/). Includes the two-tier humano.md and project.md policies.

doc-maintainer.title: Documentation Maintenance
doc-maintainer.default_body: Documentation health checks: broken links, code-doc consistency, duplicate content, content placement, dead references. Phase 1 is automated (link scripts); Phase 2 is LLM-driven.

agent-installer.title: Agent Installer
agent-installer.default_body: Install and reconfigure the agent system in a repo via the 4-phase installer. The conversational wrapper around install-agent.ps1.

questions_protocols.prompt: Which project protocols do you want to enable? (comma-separated ids; lives in docs/protocols/)
Which agent protocols do you want to enable? (comma-separated ids; lives in .opencode/protocols/)

phases.title: Phase 3 - Project Slang
phases.description: Generates the session slang snapshot template with initial entries.

questions.prompt: Project slang (lunfardo del proyecto). Format per line: term | meaning | code location | confidence (high/medium/low). Leave empty to start with a blank dictionary.
examples: polvo | powder inside a fire extinguisher | internal/domain/powder_model.go | high

questions.prompt: Default agent (primary interface for the human)
Language for documentation and comments (BCP-47 or 'en')
